تذدكرون (form VIII)
# تَذْدَكِرُونَ (taḏdakirūna) /tað.da.ki.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# تُذْدَكَرُونَ (tuḏdakarūna) /tuð.da.ka.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
